name: Daily Case Priorities Digest

parameters.content:
## Daily Case Priorities Digest

### How it works

1. Triggers every morning on a schedule and pulls every open task from Clio.
2. Groups tasks by the assigned attorney, then sorts each attorney's tasks into overdue, due today, and due this week.
3. Skips silently if nobody has anything due — no empty emails go out.
4. Builds one styled digest email per attorney and logs the send to the compliance audit log.
5. Sends the digest, with a short teaser for the full LegalContext Morning Digest at the bottom.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) first — this template logs every digest send to it for audit purposes.
- [ ] Configure Clio OAuth2 credentials with task read access.
- [ ] Configure SMTP credentials for sending the digest email.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: CLIO_BASE_URL, FIRM_NAME, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID.
- [ ] Adjust the morning schedule to match your firm's start of day.

### Customization

Set FIRM_DIGEST_FOLLOWUP_DAYS to widen or narrow the 'coming up this week' window (defaults to 7 days). Edit the section colors and copy in 'Build Morning Digest Email' to match your firm's branding, or change the LEGALCONTEXT_UPSELL_URL variable to point at your own booking link.

## Morning trigger and fetch

Scheduled trigger fires each morning and pulls every open (non-completed) task from Clio, across all attorneys.

## Group and check for items

Groups tasks by assigned attorney and buckets each into overdue, due today, or due this week. Branches to Skip if nobody has anything due.

## Build and send the digest

Fans out one item per attorney, builds their personalized digest email, logs the send to the compliance audit log, then delivers it.

nodes.name: When Morning Digest Runs
nodes.notes: Fires every day at 7am (n8n server timezone) — before the start of the firm's business day. Adjust the cron expression to match when your attorneys actually want this waiting in their inbox, or restrict it to weekdays only (e.g. '0 7 * * 1-5') if a weekend digest isn't useful.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Tasks From Clio
nodes.notes:
Pulls every task still marked 'pending' in Clio, regardless of attorney — the next step splits them out per attorney. Same bills/tasks.json request pattern as PAC-59/61, with 'pending' as the status value.

'due_at' is the field name used across this catalog whenever a Clio task is created (see NTC-16, PAC-59) but hasn't independently been confirmed on this endpoint's GET response — check your first real run's output and adjust the field name here if it comes back under a different key.

Credential: same Clio OAuth2 credential as PAC-18/20/55/57/58/59/61 — reuse it if already deployed.

Returns up to 200 tasks per run. If your firm regularly has more open at once, add a loop over the 'page' parameter.

nodes.name: Group Tasks By Attorney And Bucket
nodes.notes: Tasks with no assignee email or no due date are silently excluded — there's nobody to send them to, or no date to sort them by. Tasks due further out than FIRM_DIGEST_FOLLOWUP_DAYS are excluded too; this is a morning digest, not a full task list.

nodes.name: If Any Attorney Has Digest Items
nodes.notes:
Yes (at least one attorney has an overdue, due-today, or follow-up task) → build and send digests.
No (every open task is either far enough out to be excluded, or there simply aren't any) → route to Skip. No emails sent.

nodes.name: Skip — Nothing To Digest Today
nodes.notes: No attorney had anything overdue, due today, or coming up this week. Expected on a quiet day — no digest email sent.

nodes.name: Split Digest By Attorney
nodes.notes: Fans out into one item per attorney who has at least one digest-worthy task — everything downstream builds and sends one attorney's digest email at a time.

nodes.name: Build Morning Digest Email
nodes.notes:
Builds one styled digest email per attorney with three sections (overdue, due today, this week) and a short teaser linking to the full LegalContext Morning Digest product. This is an internal firm email — no client is ever contacted by this workflow.

LEGALCONTEXT_UPSELL_URL is optional — falls back to a generic protomated.com link if unset.

nodes.name: Log Digest Send Event
nodes.notes:
Logs the digest send to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet via the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33). This is internal record-keeping, not a message to a client — opt-out checking doesn't apply here, same as PAC-59/60/61's internal notifications.

The guardrail workflow ID is read from the GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID n8n Variable.

nodes.name: Send Morning Digest Email
nodes.notes:
Delivers the digest to the attorney. Reads all fields explicitly from 'Build Morning Digest Email' rather than $json — the guardrail call immediately upstream replaced the item's json with its own response.

Credential: project → Credentials tab → New → search SMTP → save as 'Email account (SMTP)'.

description: Fires every morning, pulls every open task from Clio, and groups it by assigned attorney into overdue, due today, and due this week. Sends each attorney one styled digest email covering all three — skipping silently on quiet days — and logs every send to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet. Entirely internal, no client is ever contacted. Ends with a short teaser for the full LegalContext Morning Digest, which adds case status, billing alerts, and an AI-summarized action list.
